description: This file contains unit tests for the ConnectionId class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package. It verifies immutability, equality and hashcode correctness, dummy state recognition, and string representation.

classes.name: ConnectionIdTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for the ConnectionId class, checking immutability, equality, dummy state, and string conversion.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ConnectionId instances are immutable, considering EntityId's immutability.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Checks that the equals and hashCode methods in ConnectionId are correctly implemented using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: placeholderIsPlaceholder
methods.description: Asserts that the dummy ConnectionId is recognized as a placeholder.

methods.name: manuallyCreatedPlaceholderIsPlaceholder
methods.description: Asserts that a ConnectionId created with underscore is recognized as a dummy.

methods.name: randomlyGeneratedIsNoPlaceholder
methods.description: Confirms that a generated random ConnectionId is not considered a dummy.

methods.name: randomlyGeneratedIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks that a randomly generated ConnectionId string representation is not empty.

methods.name: connectionIdOfConnectionIdIsSameInstance
methods.description: Ensures that copying a ConnectionId results in the same instance, verifying reference equality.

methods.name: toStringEqualsInput
methods.description: Verifies that the toString() method of ConnectionId returns the original string used to create it.
